metadata.authority_role: Changes, effective March 18, 2013, how the existing child support exclusion applies when an ineligible or disqualified member's income is prorated: child support paid by all EU members is totalled and deducted first from that member's gross income, with any remainder deducted from eligible members' income; the 20% earned income deduction moves to after proration. It replaces the ineligible-member steps IM-39 (2003) prints.
